summary.text: Use the Healthier SG search to find an enrolment station or check whether a clinic participates.

steps.name: Open the search
steps.text: Open https://gowhere.gov.sg/healthiersg to check for the nearest Healthier SG Enrolment Station or participating clinics.

steps.name: Enter your search
steps.text: Enter your postal code to find a nearby station, or enter the name of your GP or polyclinic to check if it is participating.

example_phrasings: Where is the Healthier SG Enrolment Station nearest to me?
How do I check if my GP or polyclinic participates?
How can I find a Healthier SG Enrolment Station?

sources.page_title: Where is the Healthier SG Enrolment Station nearest to me? How can I check if my GP / polyclinic is participating in Healthier SG?

quotes.text: You may check for your nearest Healthier SG Enrolment Station and the list of participating clinics at https://gowhere.gov.sg/healthiersg .
Simply enter your postal code or name of clinic to search.
